name: Orbital Drop Pod
description: A single-use reentry vehicle designed to deliver personnel or cargo from orbit to surface in minutes. A ceramic heat shield, a retro-rocket package, and a prayer. Drop pods are deployed from orbital stations when something on the ground needs an immediate response that can't wait for a shuttle. The reentry is violent, the landing is harder, and the contents arrive hot, disoriented, and ready. Seeing a drop pod streak across the GLMZ sky means something significant is about to hit the ground.
propulsion: Orbital deceleration rockets, parachute/retro-rocket terminal descent
speed: Terminal velocity on descent, 0 on arrival (ideally)
autonomy: Automated descent with manual override for occupant
armament: None. The pod itself is a kinetic weapon if the retro-rockets fail.
common_usage: Emergency personnel deployment, priority cargo delivery, orbital-to-surface insertion.
story_hooks: A drop pod lands in a Tier 1 district and no one claims it — the occupant walks out and disappears into the crowd
Three drop pods land simultaneously in three different districts, each containing an identical sealed case
physical_description: A scorched, bullet-shaped capsule roughly three meters long, its ablative ceramic heat shield streaked with black char and stress fractures from multiple reentries. Welded titanium frame shows dents and hasty repairs; retro-rocket nozzles are crusted with oxidation. A single reinforced hatch with mechanical locks dominates one end, its hinges worn smooth from emergency egress.
visual_prompt: Arcturus Defense orbital drop pod, scarred ceramic heat shield, charred black and scorched white, titanium frame with welded seams, retro-rocket nozzles oxidized, mechanical hatch, industrial decay, gritty product photography, dark rain-slicked hangar background, moody neon reflection, near-future military hardware, worn and battle-tested, detailed weathering, neo-noir atmosphere, studio lighting
